# Verification Result

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:VerificationResult`](gmeow-VerificationResult.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/VerificationResult>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/attestation`](../../slices/attestation.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An information object recording the outcome of a verification activity — verified, failed, unverified, expired, revoked, policy-failed, finality-pending, etc. A verification result is an observation output, not an axiom of correctness ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:VerificationResult`](gmeow-VerificationResult.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

### Software Release

- **Source:** [`slices/core/attestation/examples/software-release.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/attestation/examples/software-release.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-attestation-examples-software-release)#example-slices-core-attestation-examples-software-release

```turtle
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Blackcat Informatics® Inc. <paudley@blackcatinformatics.ca>
# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0
#
# Worked example: a supply-chain attestation. A gmeow:Attestation binds an
# gmeow:attester (who vouches) to an gmeow:attestedSubject (what is vouched for)
# under an gmeow:attestationType drawn from the open vocabulary of real formats
# (SLSA provenance, in-toto, DSSE, C2PA, verifiable credential, …). Here a CI
# pipeline issues a SLSA-provenance attestation over a release bundle, carries
# the signed artifact, and a relying party records a gmeow:VerificationResult —
# the attestation is a claim; verifying it is a separate, recorded act.
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/attestation/> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .

# --- Verification is its own recorded act: the deploy gate checked the chain.
ex:verifyResult a gmeow:VerificationResult ;
    gmeow:hasVerificationStatus gmeow:verificationStatusVerified ;
    gmeow:verifiedBy            ex:relyingParty .
```

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the OUTCOME a verifier reached when checking an attestation — verified, failed, expired, revoked, policy-failed, finality-pending — as a held observation output carrying its own status, verifier, and time.

### Avoid when

- Avoid reading a 'verified' result as a global truth verdict — it records what one verifier observed under one policy at one time, not that the underlying claim is correct ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)); competing results from different verifiers coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Mint the result, set [`gmeow:hasVerificationStatus`](../properties/gmeow-hasVerificationStatus.md) (the EL minimum), name [`gmeow:verifiedBy`](../properties/gmeow-verifiedBy.md) and the time, and link it from the [`Attestation`](gmeow-Attestation.md) with [`gmeow:verificationResult`](../properties/gmeow-verificationResult.md); treat a later contradicting result as another coexisting [`VerificationResult`](gmeow-VerificationResult.md), not an overwrite.

### Examples

- ex:verifyOutcome a [`gmeow:VerificationResult`](gmeow-VerificationResult.md); [`gmeow:hasVerificationStatus`](../properties/gmeow-hasVerificationStatus.md) [`gmeow:verificationStatusVerified`](../individuals/gmeow-verificationStatusVerified.md).
